name: University of Gothenburg
summary: A city-centre university of 58,000 students in Gothenburg; English bachelor's from business and IR to music, opera and craft.

ib.text: No IB page of its own; the national rules apply. A full IB Diploma gives general entry, and IB English meets English 6. Subjects count at grade 4 (3 at HL Biology, Chemistry, Physics).

programmes.name: Bachelor's Program in Business and Economics
programmes.ib: Maths AA at grade 3, or AI at 4 (AI HL at 3).
programmes.about: Business administration, economics, statistics and commercial law first, then a major in business administration, economics or financial economics, with eight specialisations and a semester abroad in year three.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.

programmes.selectionNote: April round: ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's merit scale (max 22.5); 66% of places on grades, 34% on the SweSAT (in Swedish, optional).

programmes.name: Bachelor's Program in Computer Science and AI
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL at 4, or AA or AI HL at 3.
programmes.about: Two parallel tracks, computer science and AI, built on mathematics and analytical thinking from day one; taught mainly on Chalmers' Johanneberg campus. First intake in autumn 2027.
programmes.selectionNote: April round: ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's merit scale (max 22.5); 66% of places on grades, 34% on the SweSAT (in Swedish, optional). New: no past cut-off.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Program in International Relations
programmes.about: International structures and conflicts, global inequality and environmental change, with training to analyse and evaluate global challenges; taught at the School of Global Studies in central Gothenburg.
programmes.selectionNote: April round: ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's merit scale (max 22.5); 66% of places on grades, 34% on the SweSAT (in Swedish, optional).

programmes.name: Bachelor's Program in Software Engineering and Management
programmes.ib: Maths AA at grade 3, or AI at 4 (AI HL at 3).
programmes.about: Software engineering with a management angle: team projects with industry partners and hackathons, taught at Lindholmen Science Park, Gothenburg's technology hub.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.

programmes.selectionNote: April round: ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's merit scale (max 22.5); 66% of places on grades, 34% on the SweSAT (in Swedish, optional).

programmes.name: Bachelor of Fine Arts in Contemporary Traditions in Music
programmes.ib: Admission test decides; only in the January round (16 Oct–15 Jan), which needs the Diploma in hand.
programmes.about: For musicians from folk, traditional or world music, or non-Western art music such as Arabic or Indian classical: ensemble playing and projects that cross traditions.
programmes.selectionNote: IB grades don't rank you: after the IB Diploma makes you eligible, the admission tests decide. Test details are on the Academy of Music and Drama's pages.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Programme in Music, with a specialization in Classical Performance
programmes.ib: Admission test decides; only in the January round (16 Oct–15 Jan), which needs the Diploma in hand.
programmes.about: Instrumental study, chamber music, ensemble and orchestra on your instrument, with individual tuition in English or Swedish, preparing you for orchestra and freelance work.
programmes.selectionNote: IB grades don't rank you: after the IB Diploma makes you eligible, the admission tests decide. Test details are on the Academy of Music and Drama's pages.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Programme in Music, with a specialization in Improvisation Performance
programmes.ib: Admission test decides; only in the January round (16 Oct–15 Jan), which needs the Diploma in hand.

separateFrom.name: Bachelor's Programme in Music, with a specialization in Classical Performance
separateFrom.reason: A different specialisation, applied for separately (K1IMP, not K1KLA) with its own admission test; whether the two tests differ is not recorded, so they stay two cards until it is.

programmes.about: For any instrument: develop your own improvising style and compositions, with yearly joint projects with the music academies in Oslo and Tallinn. Taught in English and Swedish.
programmes.selectionNote: IB grades don't rank you: after the IB Diploma makes you eligible, the admission tests decide. Test details are on the Academy of Music and Drama's pages.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Fine Arts in Opera
programmes.ib: Admission test decides; only in the January round (December 2026 to January 2027), which needs the Diploma in hand.
programmes.about: Vocal training at the core, with drama and movement, at least one staged project a year and a great deal of individual coaching towards a career as an opera singer.
programmes.selectionNote: IB grades don't rank you: after the IB Diploma makes you eligible, the admission tests decide. Test details are on the Academy of Music and Drama's pages.

programmes.name: BFA Programme in Craft with Specialisation in Crafting Futures
programmes.ib: Work samples and an interview decide; only in the January round (16 Oct–15 Jan), which needs the Diploma in hand.
programmes.about: Craft between fine art and design at rural Campus Steneby in Dalsland: work across wood, metal, textiles, clay and a 3D lab, exploring materials, place and landscape.
programmes.selectionNote: IB grades don't rank you: your work samples are assessed, then shortlisted applicants are interviewed. Portfolio guidelines are on the programme page.

programmes.name: BFA Programme in Metal Art
programmes.ib: Work samples and an interview decide; only in the January round (16 Oct–15 Jan), which needs the Diploma in hand.
programmes.about: Forging, fabrication, welding, sheet-metal forming and casting in a 1,200 m² metal workshop at Campus Steneby, Dals Långed, 170 km north of Gothenburg.
programmes.selectionNote: IB grades don't rank you: your work samples are assessed, then shortlisted applicants are interviewed. Portfolio guidelines are on the programme page.

programmes.name: BFA Programme in Wood Oriented Furniture Design
programmes.ib: Work samples and an interview decide; only in the January round (16 Oct–15 Jan), which needs the Diploma in hand.
programmes.about: Furniture design through project modules with an exploratory, material-led approach, plus materials, techniques and design method, in Campus Steneby's wood workshops.
programmes.selectionNote: IB grades don't rank you: your work samples are assessed, then shortlisted applicants are interviewed. Portfolio guidelines are on the programme page.

notes: Business and Economics, Computer Science and AI, International Relations and Software Engineering also take applications from 15 March to 15 April 2027, the round for May IB candidates.
The music and craft programmes run only in the January round, which is not for students still finishing the IB; for 2026 Contemporary Traditions wanted proof of general entry by 26 January.
The three craft BFAs are taught at Campus Steneby in Dals Långed, 170 km north of Gothenburg; Metal Art takes six to eight students a year.
